strings.collections.case_templates.template_abdo: Abdominal aortic aneurysm with surgical indications
The aneurysm continued to enlarge and was at risk of rupture, and open abdominal aortic aneurysm repair was scheduled.
A checkup found that a large blood vessel in my abdomen had widened. Sometimes I can feel it pulsing.
Localized dilatation of the abdominal aorta.
The size and shape of the aneurysm reach the range of surgical evaluation, and the relationship between branch vessels needs to be clarified.
Enhanced imaging and preoperative evaluation are available.
The patient wished to preserve her uterus and discussed open myomectomy and the possibility of recurrence.
My periods have always been very heavy and keep lasting longer. I feel weak all the time.
The location and number of fibroids are suitable for planning uterine-sparing surgery.
Multiple fibroid-like nodules were seen in the uterine body.
Tumor location and extent require evaluation by open abdominoperineal proctectomy.
I keep seeing blood when I use the toilet, and even when I feel the urge, it never feels completely emptied.
The location of the lesion is low and radical surgical planning is required.
Circular mass was seen in the low rectum.
No clear distant metastasis was seen.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_appe: The patient's condition and imaging warranted an appendectomy as soon as possible.
The pain in my lower right abdomen keeps getting worse, and even walking pulls at it.
There were inflammatory changes around the appendix in the right lower abdomen, and no clear abscess was found.
The appendix becomes thickened and the surrounding fat echo changes.
The proportion of white blood cells and neutrophils increased.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_brea: The surgical procedure is local tumor resection, and the final extent is subject to intraoperative and pathological evaluation.
I found a small hard lump in my breast while showering. It does not hurt much when I press it.
It is suggested that localized breast malignant tumors require surgical resection and pathology.
Localized irregular high-density shadows require histological confirmation.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_cabg: After evaluation by the cardiac team, open coronary artery bypass grafting was scheduled.
Lately, whenever I walk quickly or climb stairs, my chest feels crushed and I cannot catch my breath.
There are significant stenoses in multiple coronary arteries that are suitable for revascularization evaluation.
Ischemic changes occur under exercise stress.
Regional left ventricular wall motion weakened.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_dist: The lesion was located in the distal stomach, and an open distal gastrectomy and regional lymph node evaluation were scheduled.
Recently I feel full after only a few bites, and there is a dull pain in my upper abdomen.
The disease is limited to the distal stomach, and regional lymph nodes need to be evaluated.
Ulcerative lesions were seen in the gastric antrum.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_esop: The lesion was within the resectable range, and open esophagectomy and reconstruction evaluation were scheduled.
Swallowing has become increasingly difficult—first solid food, and now even soft food must be swallowed slowly.
Pathology showed esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
Stenotic lesions were seen in the thoracic esophagus.
No clear distant metastasis was seen.
The lesion is limited to the chest and surrounding lymph nodes need to be evaluated.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_expl: The cause and extent cannot be completely determined through imaging, and emergency open exploration is required.
My abdomen suddenly began hurting terribly, it keeps swelling, and I cannot stop feeling sick.
Explain the indication, confirm consent, and continue
Use the worst-case outcome to pressure her into continuing
The reported symptoms remain inconsistent with objective findings and an external motive may be present. This conclusion cannot be established from a single interview alone.
There are complex inflammatory changes in the abdominal cavity, and the cause and extent still need to be confirmed by surgical exploration.
White blood cells were significantly elevated.
Elevated lactate indicates that tissue perfusion requires close attention.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_hyst: Due to persistent symptoms and limited response to conservative management, hysterectomy and alternatives were discussed.
My periods have been frighteningly heavy for the past few months, and my lower abdomen always feels weighed down.
The hemoglobin was low, consistent with chronic blood loss anemia.
The distribution and size of fibroids are suitable for surgical evaluation.
Multiple fibroid-like nodules were seen in the uterus, and the largest one obviously compressed the uterine cavity.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_ingu: Symptomatic hernias are candidates for open inguinal hernia repair.
When I stand up, a lump appears beside my groin.
No obvious infection or anemia was seen.
When abdominal pressure increases, hernia contents may pass through the inguinal canal.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_live: If the lesion is localized and the remaining liver reserve is acceptable, open liver lobectomy is scheduled for evaluation.
A checkup found a nodule in my liver. I normally do not feel anything unusual.
No clear distant metastasis was seen.
A solitary enhancing mass with imaging features consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma.
Some liver enzymes are abnormal, but the synthesis function is acceptable.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_lung: If the lesion is limited to a single lobe and lung function permits, a thoracotomy lobectomy is scheduled.
A checkup found a small nodule in my lung, and I have indeed been coughing a lot lately.
Pathology showed non-small cell lung cancer.
Nodules with irregular borders were seen in a single lung lobe.
The metabolism of the lesion increased, and no clear distant metastasis was found.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_neph: The location and extent of the tumor are not suitable for nephron preservation, and open nephrectomy is scheduled for evaluation.
A checkup found a mass on my kidney. I only notice an occasional ache in my flank.
No clear distant metastasis was seen.
A localized solid enhancing mass was seen in the kidney.
Contralateral renal function and overall renal function were acceptable.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_open: Inflammation recurred and symptoms persisted, and an open cholecystectomy was scheduled.
The area under my right ribs keeps hurting, especially after I eat something fatty.
Supporting acute cholecystitis, no clear distant lesions were seen.
The gallbladder wall is thickened and stones are present, and there are inflammatory changes around it.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_ovar: With the goal of preserving ovarian tissue, an open ovarian cyst resection was arranged and sent to pathology.
My lower abdomen becomes bloated and painful in waves, especially around my period.
The lesion boundaries and relationship to surrounding tissues are suitable for surgical evaluation.

The results need to be combined with imaging and pathological judgment.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_pneu: The extent of the tumor required complete lung resection to obtain radical resection margins, and thoracotomy pneumonectomy was scheduled for evaluation.
I have been coughing for months, and recently there has been a little blood in my sputum.

Central masses involve the main bronchus, making it difficult to obtain safe margins during single-lobectomy.

Contralateral lung reserve assessment was acceptable.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_radi: Pathology showed myometrial invasion, and open radical cystectomy was scheduled and urinary diversion discussed.
Several times recently, there has suddenly been a lot of blood in my urine, but no pain at all.
Infiltrative mass was seen on the bladder wall.
Radical surgery and lymph node evaluation are required.
It indicates that the tumor has reached the bladder muscle layer.
The urine contained red blood cells and there was no clear evidence of infection.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_righ: The tumor was located in the right colon, and an open right hemicolectomy was scheduled.
I tire very easily lately, and my bowel habits are different from before.
A ring-shaped mass was seen in the ascending colon, causing partial lumen stenosis.
No clear distant metastasis has been seen yet.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_sigm: The tumor location is suitable for open sigmoidectomy.
The lower left side of my abdomen hurts now and then. My stool has become narrow and sometimes contains blood.
Localized tumors and strictures were seen in the sigmoid colon.
No clear distant metastasis was seen.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_sple: Localized space-occupying lesions of the spleen
The lesion caused compressive symptoms and the nature was unknown, so an open splenectomy was arranged.
My upper left abdomen has felt bloated lately, and I become full after just a few bites.
There is limited space occupied by the spleen, and the boundary and blood supply need to be confirmed by surgery and pathology.
The metabolic status of the lesion needs to be combined with pathological judgment, and no clear distant lesions have been found.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_tota: If the lesion is not suitable for local resection, open total gastrectomy is discussed.
I become painfully bloated after eating very little, and I have lost a lot of weight.
A wide range of infiltrative lesions were seen in the gastric body and proximal end.
No clear distant metastasis was seen, and surgical evaluation was required.
The disease was extensive, and a total mastectomy was scheduled and reconstruction and lymph node management discussed.
The tests found problems in more than one part of my breast, and I can feel hard areas myself.
The lesions are relatively wide and not suitable for simple local excision.
For multifocal breast cancer, surgical plans need to be formulated based on staging.
Multifocal abnormal calcifications and mass shadows in the ipsilateral breast.
Further sampling during surgery is required for confirmation.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_vent: If the defect is large and symptoms progress, open abdominal wall hernia repair is scheduled.
A bulge has appeared beside my old surgical scar, especially when I strain.
Incisional abdominal wall defect and hernia sac were seen, but intestinal ischemia was not seen.
strings.collections.case_templates.template_whip: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma of head of pancreas
The imaging suggested a resectable pancreatic head lesion, and an open pancreaticoduodenectomy was scheduled for evaluation.
The whites of my eyes have been turning yellow and my urine is very dark, though my abdomen hardly hurts.
It is suggestive of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
The lesion is consistent with the origin of the pancreatic head, and the vascular relationship needs to be evaluated.
Bilirubin and cholestasis markers are elevated.
The head of the pancreas occupies space and compresses the common bile duct.

strings.collections.character_events.ange_lv1_ha: An Qi reorganized the three scattered remarks into one sentence.
——Epilogue: The next day, the nurse’s station.
Sakaguchi saw Angel again. She was underlining the shift notes and combining three scattered notes into one sentence. The bunny sticker was not folded this time.
Seeing Sakaguchi, she took the initiative to say hello.
"Good morning. Bed Six was in stable condition last night."
An Qi reorganized the three scattered remarks into one sentence.
Angel was still confirming the shift handover details after get off work.
Sakaguchi has finished his ward rounds and is preparing to leave the ward.
Next to the nurse's station, An Qi was holding the shift record and explaining the situation to the taking over nurse.
"Six beds need to pay attention to their eating tonight. I only ate less than half of my lunch. I didn't feel sick in the afternoon, but I didn't drink much water."
The taking over nurse marked the record.
"Okay, I understand. I'll do the rest."
"Also, when he says he feels discomfort in his abdomen, he will first say, 'Maybe I'm too sensitive.' You can ask more."
An Qi handed the record out and took it back.
"By the way, the family members brought it——"
"Dr. Sakaguchi. Are there any new medical orders for bed six?"
"No. What time do you get off work?"
She glanced at the clock on the wall.
"She's done it once. This is the second time."
Angel's ears are a little red.
"I missed some details the first time."
Sakaguchi took the record and looked at it.
The handwriting is neat, and several easily overlooked places are marked in different colors. There was a small rabbit sticker stuck to the corner of the paper, which she folded in half.
She realized that Sakaguchi had seen it, and subconsciously stretched out her hand to press the corner of the paper.
SakaguchiReturn the record to the relief nurse.
"I understand the situation of the six beds. If there are changes at night, please contact us according to the on-duty arrangements."
"When he says it's okay...it doesn't necessarily mean it's okay."
The taking over nurse shook the record in her hand.
"I remember it. He first said, 'Maybe I'm too sensitive,' so I asked one more question."
An Qi looked at her, then at Sakaguchi, and finally nodded.
——Transition: at the entrance of the hospital.
An Qi changed into casual clothes and came out, carrying a small bag on her shoulder that was much lighter than when working. When she saw Sakaguchi, her steps slowed down.
She looked down at her phone and the screen lit up.
"The next one is in seven minutes."
The two of them walked along the way to the station.
An Qi walked for a while and suddenly asked:
"Am I too long-winded in my shift handover?"
"Some things can be sorted out in advance. The one about six beds is worth talking about."
An Qi put her mobile phone into her bag, moved the corners of her mouth, and quickly returned to her normal appearance.
When she reached the intersection, she glanced at the bus stop and suddenly quickened her pace.
She had walked out and stopped again.
She trotted into the convenience store and the bell on the door rang.
Angel was still confirming the shift handover details after get off work.
strings.collections.character_events.ange_lv2_ex: On the day of surgery, she kept her promise to accompany the patient in.
——Epilogue A: The next day, the entrance to the surgical area.
The patient is brought to the surgical area. An Qi went up to her and told her name first.
"Let's check the information first. Then I'll accompany you in."
The patient looked at her and nodded.
When Sakaguchi passed by, he heard the patient whisper:
——Epilogue B: Resting place after the operation.
An Qi sat down and finally opened the cookies that she had never eaten. Sakaguchi comes in and pours water.
"When the patient went in, she was not as nervous as yesterday."
After she finished speaking, she added:
Angel squeezed the cookie bag loudly.
"I'm afraid she'll ask me something that I don't even know."
"Then I got busy and couldn't care less about it."
She lowered her head and picked out an unbroken cookie and handed it to Sakaguchi.
An Qi looked at the remaining broken cookies in her hand and suddenly smiled softly.
"The answers I prepared last night are useless today."
On the day of surgery, she kept her promise to accompany the patient in.
Angel prepared all the answers, but encountered the question that the patient was really afraid of.
When Sakaguchi walked into the ward, An Qi was explaining the arrangements for the next day to an adult female patient.
She was so well prepared that she barely had to look down at the information.

"The ward nurse will accompany you tomorrow morning. After entering the surgery area, we will check your identity and surgery information again. Your belongings can be handed over to your family members for safekeeping first—"
The patient answered quickly. Ange turned the page.
"Do you have anything else to ask?"
"Then please prepare according to the requirements just explained tonight. If there is any-"
The patient clutched the corners of the quilt.
"We will always have someone with you. The anesthesiologist has also talked to you about this operation-"
"I'm sorry, I just couldn't help it."
An Qi lowered her head and glanced at the information. The answers to the above questions that may be asked have already been written.
"Which part are you most afraid of now?"
The patient hesitated for a moment.
"Everyone knows what to do. Only I don't know. I'm afraid I won't even know where to lie down by then."
An Qi raised her eyes. The patient smiled again, this time more embarrassed.
"You don't have to remember that. When tomorrow comes, I'll tell you what to do next."
She looked back at the patient.

An Qi pulled out the small card tucked into the information. It contains the order of explanations she has arranged in advance, and the last line is: confirm patient understanding and answer questions.
As soon as the words came out of her mouth, she felt a little regretful. Sakaguchi didn't smile.
"You just said what she needs most tomorrow."
An Qi looked at the ward door. After a while, she wrote a few words on the back of the card and put it back in her pocket.
Angel prepared all the answers, but encountered the question that the patient was really afraid of.
strings.collections.character_events.ange_lv3_ch: An Qi took the initiative to try to schedule the next surgery.
——Epilogue: The next day, in front of the schedule.
Hiroko is confirming her schedule for the next week. An Qi came over and pointed to one of the surgeries.
"Sugimura-senpai, can I use this one with Dr. Sakaguchi?"
"So there are still some places that I want to learn again."
Hiroko made a mark on the watch.
An Qi thanked her, took a few steps, and then came back.
"Um...please don't say it was my special request."
An Qi straightened the record folder a little.
An Qi took the initiative to try to schedule the next surgery.
Angel asked Sakaguchi to confirm again before closing.
A common abdominal surgery is coming to an end.
Angel serves as the device nurse for Sakaguchi today. Several transfers were made slightly earlier than Sakaguchi. The operation went smoothly and her tight shoulders gradually relaxed.
When the final inspection before closing began, she suddenly spoke:
"The color that was attracted just now is darker than the previous one. I'm worried that there is still bleeding."
"It's not much, but I think we should recheck the location we just dealt with."
Sakaguchi looked at the field of surgery.
"No new bleeding has been seen so far."
The voice suddenly became louder. An Qi realized it herself and immediately lowered her voice.
"Okay. Tell me again the order you just saw."
An Qi was stunned for a moment and began to report. After Sakaguchi listened, he took her to confirm again.
There was no new active bleeding. What I saw just now was the residual blood, which was brought out with the flushing.
Sakaguchi motioned for her to see clearly.
"What's the difference between here and the situation you're worried about?"
An Qi observed carefully for a while.
"There is no continued leakage. There is no re-accumulation after flushing."
"You're right when you see the color getting darker. The cause was determined a little early."
Sakaguchi continues to complete the check.
An Qi was quieter than usual as she sorted out the records. When Sakaguchi came back, he found that she had not left yet.
"Is there something that doesn't match up?"
"I'm sorry for wasting your time just now."
"But you have already judged it. I still insist on it."
Sakaguchi pulled up a chair and sat down.
"What do you think we should do next time?"
An Qi thought for a while.
"Confirm my judgment first, and then report to you."
"How long does it take to confirm?"
"What if by the time you finish confirming, the situation has changed?"
"Tell me what you see. You can also tell me what you think it is. If you can't tell it clearly at the moment, just tell me that you can't tell it."
Ange looked down at the edge of the clip.
"I think a good assistant should be able to give the doctor an accurate answer."
"Of course it's good to be accurate. But when I ask you about your situation, I'm not taking a test."
"You don't have to wait until you are sure to get full marks before you speak."
An Qi seemed to want to retort, but finally just took a breath.
Sakaguchi stood up and prepared to see the patient. When she reached the door, she called to him again.
"If I still feel something is wrong next time, I will ask you to stop."
Only then did An Qi smile a little.
Angel asked Sakaguchi to confirm again before closing.
strings.collections.character_events.ange_lv4_af: After the emergency call at night, An Qi admitted for the first time that she was scared just now.
Before the emergency surgery started, An Qi had reconfirmed the needed items.
This is the most pressing situation she has ever participated in.
She answered quickly. In the first half of the race, there were no obvious problems with her coordination.
However, the situation suddenly changed during the operation, and the team's communication quickly became intensive. Just as An Qi received a request, another voice came over.
Her hands stopped on the instrument table.
What Sakaguchi wants is right in front of you. She knows.
But at that moment, the name and location of the device seemed to be separated.
She stretched out her hand, then stopped.
Sakaguchi reiterated what is currently needed, only this one thing. An Qi handed it over.
"Yes. Follow me next, one by one."
Hiroko next to her made up the rest of the preparations. The surgery continues.
After a while, when Sakaguchi made another request, An Qi was able to respond accurately. She didn't stop again.
The patient was transferred safely to postoperative care.
When An Qi finished the handover and took off her hat, she realized that the hair on her forehead had become messy with sweat.
She straightened her reflection in the lounge window twice, getting more and more confused, and finally put her hand down.
When Sakaguchi came in, she stood up immediately.
"I know what you're going to say. Sit down and talk."
Ange sat back on the edge of her chair. Sakaguchi sat down opposite her.
"I heard it and I know what to get."
"But all of a sudden... they were all crowded together."
"Have you ever encountered this situation before?"
The room was quiet for a while.
This was said very lightly. She immediately added:
"It's not seeing blood. That's not what I'm afraid of."
"I'm afraid I won't be able to keep up. You're already taking care of it, and everyone else knows what to do, but I—"
She paused and wiped the corners of her eyes with her fingers.
Sakaguchi pushed the tissue box over. An Qi drew one, but didn't use it immediately.
"Do you think it would be better to change it to someone else next time?"
"For the same urgent surgery, a senior nurse will still be arranged to take you next time."
"You caught up again in the second half of today. That part counts."
An Qi held the tissue and nodded after a while.

The two of them reorganized what happened at that time: at what moment did she start to be unable to take care of things, what matters should be handed over to others in time, and how to make Sakaguchi requests clearer to her.
At the end of the sentence, she finally leaned back in her chair.
"When you asked me to look over there just now...I heard you clearly again."
"If you can't take care of it in the future, tell me earlier."
"I don't want to always feel like I need to be taken care of."
"Hiroko helped you today, and you will help others next time."
After a moment, she said softly:
"When I was a kid, I heard people say that my father was great."
Sakaguchi waited for her to continue.
"So I always feel that since I have chosen this profession..."
She lowered her head and folded the tissue.
"At least it should be done decently."
An Qi glanced at him. He did not question his father.
She swallowed back what she was about to say and nodded slightly.
When Sakaguchi was about to leave, An Qi stopped him.
"See the patient one more time, then get off work."
"Then...after you finish reading, can you come back?"
An Qi also seemed to find this request a bit sudden.
"I want to go to the station. Now that I'm walking alone, I might still be thinking about what happened just now."
She let go of the tissue she had been clutching.
When Sakaguchi came back, she had washed her face and combed her hair again.
But after seeing him, she didn't stand up straight as usual.
She picked up her bag and walked over to him.
"Can you walk a little slower today?"
After the emergency call at night, An Qi admitted for the first time that she was scared just now.
strings.collections.character_events.ange_lv5_ca: The patient remembered Angel's voice, and she also said her next request.
The two of them went to the ward together.
The patient's recovering voice was still a little weak, but she recognized Angel.
"You were the one who picked me up when I went in."
"I remember. I'm wearing a hat and mask, but I remember my voice."
After walking out of the ward, An Qi remained silent.
She shook her head and smiled again.
"I thought patients would only remember the surgeon."
An Qi thought about this answer for a while.
Back at the nurse's station, Hiroko asked her to sort out the preparations she had adjusted yesterday for future reference. An Qi agreed.
Sakaguchi was about to leave, but she followed him out.
"Dr. Sakaguchi, I want to ask something."
"Were you worried when the plan was changed midway yesterday?"
"You have to explain clearly what to do next."
An Qi lowered her head and thought for a while.
"I used to think that a good doctor would rarely encounter anything he was unsure about."
"Now I feel...even after things change, it's really cool to still be able to let everyone know where to go."
An Qi also laughed, and then calmed down a little.
Someone was pushing a cart in the corridor. The two men stepped aside.
An Qi waited for the car to pass before continuing:
"There will be surgeries suitable for me to participate in in the future, please call me."
"Something more complicated is fine. If you need to learn it in advance, I will prepare it."
"It will be arranged according to your ability."
She nodded as if she had received an important answer.
Sakaguchi just turned around and was stopped by her again.
"And...it's not just when we're short of people."
An Qi stood there, holding the record folder. In the seriousness that she tried so hard to maintain, she finally showed a little bit of embarrassment.
"If you think it would be easier for me to cooperate..."
She didn't answer immediately. After a while, she said:
——Epilogue C: That evening, the nurse’s station.
An Qi was sitting at the nurse's station, sorting out the postoperative review.
The first page contains the instruction card I used when I first joined the company. It's full of words, and there are a few notes on the back that were added later.
She turned to a new page and carefully wrote down the areas that needed improvement the most yesterday.
Halfway through writing, she took out her phone and opened the chat window with her family.
A line of text was entered.
After pausing for a moment, I deleted it and re-wrote it.
"The doctor said today that I am cooperating very well."
After the message was sent, she put her phone on the table and continued writing notes.
Not long after, the phone lit up.
An Qi picked it up almost immediately, read the reply, lowered her head and smiled.
She answered so quickly that she even noticed it.
The patient remembered Angel's voice, and she also said her next request.
Please call me next time · The next day
A complex surgery tests the two's collaboration.
Before the end of the pre-operative meeting, Sakaguchi reconfirmed the arrangements.

This is a more difficult operation and is expected to take a longer time. Senior staff will be present, and An Qi will be responsible for the equipment coordination that she has trained and passed the confirmation.
After listening to the division of labor, she opened her notes.
"If this stage takes longer than expected, I hope to notify the circulating nurse in advance to prepare follow-up items."
Sakaguchi looked at where she pointed.
"Okay. Let's explain it together during the handover."
After the meeting, An Qi stayed.
"Dr. Sakaguchi, you didn't ask me today."
She was stunned for a moment.
Then he lowered his head to check his notes, hiding the smile that he didn't have time to retract.
In the middle of the operation, the actual situation was more complicated than the preoperative judgment.
Sakaguchi did not continue immediately. He first re-evaluated with his assistant and then adjusted the follow-up arrangements.
After An Qi listened, she repeated the part she needed to cooperate with.
She turned to the circulating nurse and spelled out the new preparation requirements.
During the whole process, she did not raise her voice.
During the next operation, she found that she could not clearly see the location of the device Sakaguchi was using.
"Dr. Sakaguchi, my field of vision is limited, please confirm."
Another thing that needed to be prepared was not yet in place, and she reported directly without forcing herself to handle everything at the same time.
While waiting, she suddenly realized that her heartbeat was still very fast.
But she knew what to do now.
Sakaguchi stretched out his hand. She handed the instrument over steadily.
Sakaguchi thanked the team and specifically mentioned everyone’s cooperation during the intraoperative adjustments.
When it was Angel's turn, he said:
"You made a good connection with that change in the middle."
After saying that, she took another look at the completed technique field.
It was like I didn't really believe that the surgery was over until this moment.
A complex surgery tests the two's collaboration.
Please call me next time too
strings.collections.character_events.aqua_intro_: Gynecology chief's new equipment testing accident.
Your judgment is quick and stable

When asked about the second menstrual cycle, Aqua suddenly stopped recording. Instead of scaring the patient with exaggerated terms, she simply reaffirmed the amount of bleeding, location of pain, and symptoms of anemia.
"There is no rush to do invasive tests today. Let's complete the ultrasound and complete blood count first, and then decide on the next step."
In a few sentences, she had grasped the real priority issues from a bunch of scattered fears.
Sakaguchi finally understood why a 28-year-old doctor sat in the position of director.
Are you a patient?
Pick up the remote control for her first

The door to the gynecological examination room was ajar. As soon as Sakaguchi approached, there was a sound coming from inside, but it was clear that she had been waiting for a while.
"...Is anyone there?"
The new electric examination chair lies almost completely flat, but the leg rests are raised to the highest position. A blue-haired female doctor in a white coat was stuck between the back of the chair and the leg rest. She couldn't reach the remote control that had fallen to the ground even if she stretched her arms.
When she saw Sakaguchi, her expression immediately became serious.
"Please do me a favor."
Sakaguchi Longsi, please give me more advice.
I will respect the confidentiality of acceptance records

A knock on the door interrupted their conversation.
"Director, the next patient has arrived."
Sakaguchi turned to look at her.
"Director?"
The blue-haired doctor straightened her back again, and the remaining embarrassment disappeared instantly.
"Yes. Aqua Mizuki, director of gynecology. What happened just now belongs to the equipment acceptance record, not to department rumors."
At least the conclusion is clear
Read the first page next time

The motor ran quietly, and the chair back and leg rest finally returned to their normal positions. She stood up and straightened her white coat, as if it was just a very ordinary inspection.
Sakaguchi pointed to the brand new manual on the corner of the table.
"Where's the manual?"
"There."
"Did you read it?"
"The buttons look intuitive."

Accept this consultation partner

The new artificial-heart system is running steadily. Dual counts, closure, transfer, and postoperative handoff are complete.

This was a teaching case, but it was also a real advanced operation completed successfully.

Sayaka did not let go of her hand.

Sayaka arches one eyebrow.

strings.collections.special_event_steps.satsuki_:
Aqua is already walking away.
“Quickly.”
Satsuki hurries after her with the charts. “Chief, what do you mean by live—”

GYNECOLOGY NURSES’ STATION — DAY
Satsuki is sorting charts behind the counter when Aqua walks straight toward her.
“Oh. Dr. Sakaguchi will not affect the angle of the leg supports.”

“I called him. It’s new.”
Aqua pats the examination chair’s armrest.
“Because you are here. We are only testing positioning. No examination.”
Satsuki remains standing and glances unmistakably at Sakaguchi. Aqua follows her gaze and finally understands.
“The leg-support angle is not the problem!”

Satsuki stops for half a beat when she sees Sakaguchi.
“…D-Dr. Sakaguchi.”

Satsuki exhales slowly.
“…This is only a test, right? No surprise examination?”

GYNECOLOGY EXAM ROOM
A new electric examination chair stands in the center. Sakaguchi is reading its manual beside the controls.
“Aqua wants to see whether the team’s positions get in the way during actual use.”

Sakaguchi takes two steps back on his own.
“I will stand here. If that is still uncomfortable, I can leave.”

Satsuki looks from the chair to Aqua.
“So… who is the live subject?”

Sakaguchi merely greets her and does not approach. Satsuki adjusts her glasses.
“W-Why are you in gynecology…?”
Aqua lowers the support another notch.
Satsuki remains in uniform and wears her black-framed glasses. Her legs rest in the supports under a proper medical drape. Sakaguchi stays at a distance, watching the equipment and team positions.

Satsuki’s expression shifts from alarm to thought.
“…You did not tell me it was about to move.”

Aqua pauses and writes on her clipboard.
“Warn the patient before a position change.”

FIRST TIME IN THE PATIENT’S POSITION
Satsuki removes her nursing shoes, straightens her uniform skirt, and sits on the chair. Aqua gives her a medical drape.

Aqua stops immediately.
“Did it pinch you?”
“I know. But when you are lying here… you do not know when it will move.”

Without warning, Aqua presses the control.
The motor whirs; the backrest lowers as the leg supports rise slightly.
“That is exactly why it is frightening.”

Satsuki lifts her head slightly.
“Chief, stand where you would during an examination.”

Aqua moves to the foot of the chair.
“Here?”
Aqua keeps writing. Sakaguchi lowers the manual and listens closely.
“Of course. This is where I stand for the examination.”
“When a nurse is standing, it feels as though the doctor is right beside the patient. Once you lie down, all you can see is the light.”

PATIENT POV
The chair reclines. Only the ceiling and examination light remain visible. Aqua is reduced to the edge of the frame, while Sakaguchi has stepped completely out of view. The supports and preparations cannot be seen.
“You hear footsteps, drawers, and instruments… but you do not know what anyone is about to do.”
“Or tell her directly that if anything is uncomfortable, we can readjust it now.”

“I’m fi—”
Satsuki stops, surprised by herself.
“…See? I almost said, ‘I’m fine.’”
“She may feel… that saying she is uncomfortable would inconvenience everyone.”
“Are the supports pressing anywhere? Is there a gap under the lower back? Are you cold?”
“It feels like only two when you are standing. It does not when you are lying down.”
“So we cannot simply ask, ‘Are you okay?’”
“Patients do this too. Especially once they are positioned and everyone is waiting.”

PEOPLE WHO ARE UNCOMFORTABLE DO NOT ALWAYS SAY SO
Aqua asks Sakaguchi to take the usual assistant’s position. He moves beside the equipment without approaching Satsuki.
“Right. It is better to ask something specific.”
Aqua stands at the foot and Sakaguchi at the side. The patient is quickly surrounded, and Satsuki visibly tenses.
“I told you to relax, so relax.”
Sakaguchi turns his face aside, suppressing a smile. Satsuki notices and blushes more deeply.

Her voice softens into her nursing tone.
“Next, the chair will recline a little farther and the leg supports will rise.”
“It may be a little uncomfortable. If it hurts or frightens you, tell me immediately.”
The room falls quiet. Aqua writes. Satsuki is still in an embarrassing position, but she no longer avoids Sakaguchi’s gaze.

“RELAX” DOES NOT HELP
Aqua returns to the examination position with an impeccably professional expression.
“You do not have to endure it. We can stop at any time.”

Satsuki thinks for several seconds before answering seriously.
“First, tell the patient what will happen next.”
“Once the patient knows what will happen next, many things become easier.”
“Fear, physical tension—even if she wants to refuse, she knows when she needs to speak.”
Satsuki looks at him. She is still nervous, but for the first time she does not want to retreat. Instead, she looks quietly, uncertainly pleased.

Satsuki seems to have expected to keep defending her point.
“…Just like that?”
“There is not enough time. Choose one.”
“If we could change only one thing?”
“Especially that an uncomfortable patient may not speak up. I will remember that.”
“What you just described is not something a doctor can see while standing.”
“Doctors easily focus only on whether the examination can be done. You notice what the patient is thinking. That is valuable.”

AQUA’S ASSESSMENT
Aqua closes her clipboard.

Satsuki blinks, then gives a small smile.
“…Okay.”

Satsuki looks down at herself, then at the chair.
“…Being a patient?”
The motor starts again. The backrest rises; Satsuki sits up and starts to remove her feet from the supports.
“Orikawa, you are very well suited to this.”

Satsuki slowly lowers her head.
“…Thank you.”
“Yes. The backrest is going to rise.”
Satsuki puts her nursing shoes back on. Alone with Sakaguchi, the only man in the room, she adjusts her glasses as some of her tension returns.

Aqua picks up the clipboard.
“I am going to ask Equipment Services to change a few settings.”
She walks straight out.
“Even if the doctors have already decided on the process?”

Sakaguchi does not approach.
“Nurse Orikawa, thank you for what you did just now.”
“No. You showed us what people standing beside the chair cannot see.”
“A process can listen to feedback. So can a patient.”

Satsuki takes a quiet breath.
“…Dr. Sakaguchi.”
“If you think something we do will make a patient more anxious, say so directly.”

This time, she does not stammer.
“Thank you for listening to me.”

HALLWAY
Satsuki walks back toward the nurses’ station alone. After a few steps, she stops and lightly adjusts her glasses.

A very small smile reaches Satsuki’s lips.
“He listens seriously.”

She remembers Sakaguchi’s words.
“You are right.”
“Keep speaking up.”

Satsuki Orikawa — Relationship Lv1
Clinical trust has been established. She has begun to believe that her patient-centered perspective deserves to be heard by the team.

GYNECOLOGY NURSES’ STATION — BEFORE THE END OF SHIFT
Satsuki stands at the edge of the counter, turning a rotation application over and over. Artoria walks past, then comes back.
“You have been staring at that paper for a long time.”

Satsuki adjusts her black-framed glasses.
“I am only deciding… whether I should really submit it.”
“I used to want very much to become an operating-room nurse.”
“Your eyes are different when you talk about Sugimura than when you talk about other nurses.”

Satsuki blushes.
“Senior Hiroko really is remarkable. When a patient is afraid, she knows when to speak.”
“When the doctors are busy, she knows when not to interrupt. She does not panic when something goes wrong.”
“I used to think… I wanted to become that kind of nurse too.”

Satsuki’s shoulders draw inward.
“Because… there were too many male doctors in surgery.”
“Do not accept that so calmly! It makes it sound even more embarrassing!”
“It is your reason. I have no right to be ashamed of it for you.”

Satsuki falls quiet.
“But lately I have been thinking… if every time I become nervous, I choose to avoid that place—”
“Then I will never know whether I could actually do the work well.”

She looks at the application.
“…Come with me once.”

NURSING ADMINISTRATION OFFICE
Ishigami sits behind her desk. Artoria is only accompanying Satsuki; she does not speak for her.
“You want to apply for a perioperative rotation.”

Her prepared answer catches in her throat.
“Because I want to become a better nurse.”
“That is an answer, not a reason.”
“…I used to want to work in surgery. Later, because of my own problem, I went into gynecology.”
“I like my work now. But I realized I never truly let go of that wish.”

Ishigami looks toward Artoria.
“Did you bring her here to vouch for her?”
“She asked me to accompany her. The application is hers.”
“You will begin with the basics: holding, patient transport, and preoperative handoff.”
“You will not take an instrument role yet.”
“Orikawa. Do not pretend you understand something because you are nervous.”
“Ask when you do not know. Say so when you cannot do something.”
“A problem affecting a patient matters far more than your embarrassment.”

SEVERAL DAYS LATER — OR HOLDING
Satsuki is here for the first time as a rotation nurse. She still wears her black-framed glasses and adjusts them more often than usual, but her work remains orderly.

First patient: identity check, transport, handoff—complete.
Second patient: just as smooth. No incident, only one real task completed after another.
The third patient is an adult woman, Yoriko Nikaido. Her hair is under a surgical cap, and her gown and sheet cover her body. She is trying hard to appear calmer than she feels.
“I will confirm once more. Please tell me your name.”

Satsuki completes the check. The patient speaks.
“Miss Nurse.”

Satsuki does not deny it reflexively.
“…A little.”

“You really said it.”
“I’m usually the one telling everyone else not to be nervous... It doesn’t seem to work very well today.”

The patient cannot help smiling.
“It is fine. Better than lying that you cannot tell at all.”

Satsuki relaxes a little too.
“I will take you inside. I will stay until the handoff is complete.”

OPERATING-ROOM CORRIDOR
Satsuki pushes the gurney along the corridor. Sakaguchi approaches from the changing area, headed for the same operating room.

The patient looks up at her.
“The surgeon?”

The patient studies her for two seconds, then lies back down.
“…I suddenly feel more nervous.”
“Why did seeing the doctor make you more nervous…?”
The automatic door opens. The room is brighter than the corridor; the patient sees the surgical lights, table, anesthesia machine, and waiting staff all at once.

Satsuki does not hear her clearly.
“What?”

The bed moves forward another little bit.
“Wait, wait—I heard that once you go in, everyone just focuses on prep and the patient can’t find a chance to say anything—is that true?!”

THUD.
The entire gurney stops abruptly.

Satsuki looks down at the wheels and tries a little more pressure. The gurney does not move at all.
“…?”
Satsuki immediately releases the pressure. Sakaguchi looks toward the front from the side.

SIDE VIEW OF THE DOORWAY
The patient has half sat up. Her legs spread to either side, each foot braced against one side of the entrance. The gurney is halfway through, but she has barred herself in place like a human door bolt.

Satsuki looks at the wheels, then at the patient.
“…The patient is stuck.”
The scene pauses for one beat. None of the staff laugh.
Satsuki instinctively reaches to pull the gurney back, then stops. She does not touch the patient’s legs. Instead, she moves to where the patient can see her directly.
“All right. We will not go in yet.”
Everyone behind them stops. No one continues pushing. The patient takes several breaths.
“I know I already consented. I know the operation is today.”

“I will not leave before the handoff is complete.”
After several seconds, the patient slowly lowers her left foot from the frame. Satsuki still does not move the gurney.

The patient looks at the right foot still braced against the other side.

Sakaguchi turns his face slightly away. He is not mocking her; he is holding back a small smile.

One second.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.

SatsukiLook at her. It's not the first time I've seen this kind of reaction. In Level 2, she has seen patients become truly frightened when they arrive at the surgery department. She lowered her voice.

"It's not the 'I don't want it' kind of thing."

"That's it..."
She looked at the sheet she was covering.

"This morning I was still thinking about what I would eat for lunch today."

"Now I don't have any clothes, I've shaved my hair, and I'm still lying in the car."

"But I don't know what I'm doing anymore."
Satsuki put her hands on the side rails of the stretcher.
"At this point, many people will suddenly become scared."
"Do you nurses have a book specifically written on how to coax people into the operating room?"

"But Hiroko-senpai told me that if it has been confirmed before the operation and the patient is just getting more and more nervous, you can give her a little sedation first according to the doctor's orders."
Satsuki nodded. The elevator door opens.

[Preoperative sedation]
Preoperative room. Satsuki looks at the information again. Preoperative sedation orders have been checked. She checked the wristband. Just read the name.
This time, she still didn't ask the patient to tell her full name and date of birth. Satsuki is ready for injection.
The needle goes in. Yurika frowned slightly.
Push the liquid in slowly. Yurika waited for a while.
She stopped halfway through the sentence.
Just a few more moments. Yurika's eyelids are getting heavier and heavier.
"Suddenly I felt that hospitalization was a good deal."
"Don't say strange things while the medicine is taking effect."
Before she finished speaking, she had already closed her eyes.

[Error handover]
The operating room door opens. Satsuki pushed the stretcher into the handover area. The operating room nurse took the information.
The nurse looked towards the stretcher.
Yurika struggled to open her eyes.

The wristband, bed number, and information can all match each other. The only ones that haven't been re-created are:

Who is the patient herself?

Satsuki completed the handover. The stretcher is ready to enter the operating room. Yurika suddenly opened her eyes again.
"You just said...cut it on the right side?"
"Then after I wake up...can I still eat?"
Yurika closed her eyes as if relieved. The door closes.

[Yurika’s appendectomy]
The shadowless lamp was pushed overhead. White light suddenly filled the field of vision. Figures wearing hats and masks moved around. The sound became distant. Someone moved her from a stretcher to the operating table. The arms are placed. The monitor started beeping regularly.
No one heard clearly. The anesthesia mask is placed over the face.

The sound breaks. The picture is blurry. A moment of darkness.

### OR VIEW

Astoria has already brushed her hands and put on a sterile surgical gown. NanaseRen stood next to the equipment table. The patient's right lower abdomen was disinfected. The disinfectant leaves a wet, shiny color on the skin. Sterile single layer is laid out. In the end, only the surgical field on the right lower abdomen was left. Astoria stretched out her hand to confirm her position.
The hilt fell into her palm. The blade presses against the skin. Cut. The skin is separated to the sides. A small amount of bleeding is immediately absorbed by the gauze.

The electrocoagulation made a short sound. Continue to separate the subcutaneous layer. The muscularis was exposed sequentially. The retractor is introduced into the incision. The field of surgery was stretched open.
The assistant adjusts the retractor. After the peritoneum was opened, Astoria inserted into the incision. moment.
The appendix was brought into the surgical field. Mesangial treatment. Root ligation.
NanaseRen handed over the scissors. Appendectomy. Stump handling. rinse. Confirm hemostasis. Then it was closed layer by layer. Muscle layer. Subcutaneous. skin. Finally cover with dressing.

["The real patients are still in the ward"]
Outside the surgical department. Satsuki is sorting out the transshipment information. The phone rings. She picked up.
"Orikawa? When will the appendectomy patient you just received come down?"
There was a pause on the phone.
Satsuki's expression disappeared little by little.
"It turned out to be the surgical patient."
Satsuki bowed her head. Reread the information. bed number. name. Bed transfer records. Her hands began to shake.
The other side of the phone has already responded. The voice also changed.

The splint in Satsuki's hand fell to the ground.

CLATTER

She stood there, motionless.

[Recovery Room—"Mine?"]
Yurika is not fully awake yet. The abdomen has been bandaged. Satsuki stood beside the bed. Her face was paler than the patient on the bed. The nurse is recording vital signs.
Satsuki did not answer. Yurika frowned. Open your eyes slowly.
She looked down to see her belly. Covered with quilt, cannot see.
"I sent it to the wrong person."
"You were... not the one who was going to have surgery today."
Satsuki looks up. The eyes are already red.
She wanted to sit up. The pain in her abdomen made her gasp immediately.
"Wait a minute! Did you really cut out my appendix?!"
"I'm just here to heal my stomach!"
"I even asked you where to cut it along the way!"
Satsuki lowered her head. Tears have fallen.
Yurika is really angry. She was so angry that she was breathing quickly. But my abdomen hurts when I exert myself. Finally, I could only fall back on the pillow.
She held her belly under the quilt.
"My stomach hurts even when I scold you."
Satsuki stood beside the bed. Didn't leave.

["I haven't forgiven you yet"]
Later. Yurika is fully awake. Satsuki is still there.

"The original patient changed beds this morning."

"The folder didn't follow."

"The transfer order still has the old bed number."

"The surgery department also used the same information when accepting it."

"But it was me who came to the bedside to pick someone up in the end."

"I just asked you if you were Yurika."

"I didn't ask you to say your full name."

"You've been asking me the whole time why I'm doing this."
Her voice became lower and lower.
"Are you explaining now, or are you scolding yourself?"
"I was given an enema for no apparent reason."
"I was skinned for no apparent reason."
"I took off all my clothes and underwear, and you pushed me down with my bare feet."

"Then you give me the injection."

"I woke up with one more incision and one less appendix."
Satsuki looks up. Yurika didn't smile. She didn't mean to scare her. Just saying seriously:
"Don't see that I'm not scolding you anymore, just say 'it's okay' for me."
Satsuki was silent for a few seconds.
"So you let me finish the pain first before talking."

[Accident review - "I don't want to escape"]
Small conference room. Ishigami, Hiroko, Satsuki, Sakaguchi were present. The complete accident record was placed in front of Shi Shen.

"Ward handover failed."

"The operating department's identity verification also failed."
"I didn't say you had no responsibility."
"The process will stop if you complete the name and date of birth checks."
"If the operating department re-establishes identity confirmation, the process will also stop."
Satsuki did not answer immediately. Hiroko looked at her. Sakaguchi didn't speak for her either. After a while:
"I don't want to go back to my old job and hide."

"If I say now, 'I'm not suitable for surgery,' I will never touch any surgery patients again..."

"That's not responsible."

"It's just that I'm scared."
"I don't know if I am worthy of continuing to be a nurse after making such a mistake."
"I want to know what she really went through."
"I want to have my appendix removed."
The room became quiet for a moment.

"My appendix is still there."

"I'm going to have the same surgery."
"If you cut off your own appendix, Mito's won't grow back."

"I'm not trying to trade one appendix for another."

"I'm the one standing next to the bed."

"I'm the one doing the enema."

"I am the one preparing the skin."

"I was the one who asked her to take off her clothes, covered her with a drape, pushed her to the operating room, and sedated her."
Her voice began to tremble. But it didn't stop.

"But what she saw and heard as she lay there, how scared she was..."

"I actually don't know anything."

"I only know the process."
"I want to go through this process again from the patient's side."
The stone god was silent. Hiroko didn't say anything either. Finally Sakaguchi spoke.

[Invite Yurika]
Yurika can now sit up and move around. Satsuki came to the ward again. Yurika frowned immediately when she saw her standing so formally.
"Every time you stand next to my bed like this, I get nervous now."
Satsuki explained carefully. After listening to this, Yurika looked in disbelief.
"If you cut yours off, mine won't grow back."
"The head nurse Ishigami said the same thing."

"Not to make you forgive me."

"You don't have to forgive me just because I did it."
"Because I always thought I knew what it was like to be a patient."
"I realize now that I only know what it feels like to stand next to the bed."
"You're not going to ask me to make any preparations again, are you?"
Yurika laughed out loud. Satsuki blushes. Then take it seriously again:
"I hope you come and see it."

"You fell asleep that day."

"You don't know how you were put on the operating table, how you were sterilized, how you were draped, how you were cut."

"If you are willing, I hope you will stand and read it this time."
Yurika looked at her for a long time.
"And someone took the initiative to invite me to watch her appendix being cut. It should be this once in her life."
"...Please don't promote it like this when you go out."

[Morning of surgery day——Satsuki becomes a patient]
This time, Satsuki is not wearing a nurse uniform. She sits on the patient's bed. Still wearing black-rimmed glasses. Hiroko came in with a cart that was almost the same as that day. When Satsuki saw the car, her expression immediately stiffened. Hiroko stopped by the bed.
"You look a lot like Mito that day."
"Knowing and lying down are two different things."
Satsuki slowly lay on her side. Bend your knees. Hiroko put on her gloves.
When the catheter entered, Satsuki's whole body visibly stiffened.
After saying that, she was stunned. That's exactly what Yurika said at the time. Hiroko couldn't help laughing.
"The body is rejecting it on its own?"
Pour in the medicinal solution. Satsuki holds the sheets.
"It's really... much more uncomfortable than standing by."
"Wanting to go to the toilet is another matter."
Satsuki showed a very slight expression of despair.

[Satsuki’s leather preparation and clothing change]
After bowel preparation is completed. Satsuki returned to bed. Hiroko opened her leather bag. Satsuki is instantly recognizable.
"Didn't you say that you wanted to go back to the patient's side again?"

Satsuki fell silent. Following Hoshimi's preoperative preparation routine, she removed her patient gown and underwear and sat on the examination table. Hiroko spread shaving cream from the lower abdomen through the perineal area. The cold against her skin made Satsuki inhale.
"Mito must have felt the same way at that time."
The razor goes to work. Satsuki was still observing carefully. She quickly turned her face the other way.
"What about when you did it on patients before?"
Satsuki did not refute. Processing ends. Hiroko handed over the surgical cap and covering sheet.
"Next, the surgical cap and cover sheet."
Satsuki is quiet for two seconds.
"I go onto the stretcher like this?"
Hiroko deliberately imitated her usual tone.
"We follow every step of the protocol."
"Your glasses come off in the preoperative area."
Hiroko had already turned her back and unfolded the cover sheet for her.

Satsuki left her neatly folded patient gown and underwear on the chair, put on the surgical cap, and tucked all of her long hair inside it. She then lay barefoot on the stretcher. Hiroko covered her from the shoulders to the feet. Satsuki looked down at herself and said nothing for a long time.
"...I know why she suddenly became scared when she got here."

[Yurika——"You look so beautiful after taking off your glasses"]
Preoperative area. Satsuki's glasses were taken off and put into a personal belongings box. The world immediately became a blur. She blinked several times. Still only colors and outlines are visible. The door opens. A man walked in wearing scrubs, a surgical cap, and a mask temporarily hung around her neck. Satsuki could only see a blurry figure.
The other party didn't answer immediately. Come closer. Go all the way to the position where Satsuki can barely make out the facial features.
Yurika stared at her for a few seconds.
She subconsciously raised her hand to push up her glasses. Her fingers touched the bridge of her empty nose. Yurika saw it and laughed.

"Really."

"Those glasses usually hide you a lot."
"Now, why are you suddenly saying this now..."
"Because now I can see it clearly for the first time."
"But I can't see anything clearly now."
"What does it have to do with whether you can see clearly or not?"
Satsuki is speechless. Yurika came closer.
"Then remember that I was complimenting you just now."

[Push to the operating room]
The stretcher started moving. This time the person with the ceiling receding is Satsuki. Yurika was following behind in a brush suit. Hiroko pushes the cart.

She paused. Think of Lv1. I remember myself saying:

Patients may not necessarily say they feel uncomfortable.

She answered again.
Satsuki watched the blurry lights above her head go by one by one.
"Did you... also look at the ceiling like that that day?"

"The first half is."

"Then after you gave me that injection, the ceiling began to become two."
"You are not allowed to talk about this today."
"Today it's your turn to be the patient."

[Operating Room - "Look into my eyes"]
The operating room door opens. Cold air and light come together. Satsuki is advanced. Yurika remains in an area where observation is allowed. Satsuki is transferred from the stretcher to the operating table. The arms are positioned as required. The monitoring patch is attached. All sounds sounded louder to her than usual. Metallic sound. Footsteps. The sound of packaging being ripped open. She couldn't see anyone's face. Only the voice is recognized. Sakaguchi has changed into surgical clothes. Go to the side of the head.
Satsuki immediately turned towards the voice.
Satsuki was silent for a second.
Satsuki looked toward him and saw only a blurred figure. She squinted hard. After a few seconds, she gave a slightly helpless smile.
"You are so gentle...but I can't see clearly."
Sakaguchi paused, then remembered how severe her myopia was. He stepped closer, then closer again, until his face changed from a blurred outline into features Satsuki could recognize.
Satsuki blinked. Look at him. This time she didn't avoid it instinctively like Lv0. On the contrary, I felt visibly relaxed.
Satsuki continued to look at him. The voice is very soft.

[Regional anesthesia, disinfection and draping]
Hiroko came to Satsuki's side.
Satsuki was assisted to lie on her side. The back is exposed. Skin disinfection. Cold disinfectant brushed against my back. Satsuki's shoulders shrank slightly.
"There will be swelling and pain. Do not move suddenly after the needle is inserted."
Satsuki grabbed the edge of the sheet. She inhaled briefly as the piercing entered.
Drug infusion. After a few minutes.
Satsuki looked at the blurred outline of her body.

"You can touch it."

"But it's not as clear as before."

The test continues. Confirm that regional anesthesia is sufficient for surgery. Satsuki lies flat again. Arms are in position. The surgical area is exposed. The abdomen was disinfected again. The disinfectant is spread from the right lower abdomen to the surrounding area. Satsuki can feel the dampness and coldness, but the boundaries are getting blurry. Yurika is already wearing a mask. Stand in a position that allows observation to the side of your head. She looked at Satsuki's lower right abdomen. That piece of skin was disinfected and draped exactly as it was a few days ago. layer. Two floors. Finally, the sterile drape left only a small surgical field in the right lower abdomen. Yurika subconsciously touched her wounds that had not yet fully recovered.
"...It turns out that I was like that that day too."

[Satsuki’s appendectomy—awake]
Sakaguchi enters the field of surgery. Instrument nurse station. Hiroko stayed near the head to look after Satsuki. Yurika is also allowed. Sakaguchi Confirm the cutout with your finger.

Instrument delivery. The blade of the knife pressed against the right lower abdomen. Satsuki can feel the cold. What follows is pressure along a line. The skin is cut. Satsuki's fingers tightened immediately.

"No pointy ones."

"It looked like someone was pushing across it with something heavy."

Continue. The subcutaneous tissue is separated. Stop bleeding. The retractor enters. The incision was stretched open. Satsuki cannot see the field of surgery. But she clearly felt that her abdominal wall was being stretched to both sides.

Yurika stood there. Hear Satsuki’s reaction to every sentence. For the first time, she knew what happened after she fell asleep. Sakaguchi continues to go deeper. The peritoneum is opened. Finger probing. Satsuki suddenly frowned.
A few seconds later. Satsuki's whole body tensed up suddenly.
"It's from the inside... being pulled upwards."
"Pull it all the way to your stomach."
Nausea suddenly came on. Satsuki closed her eyes.
Hiroko held one of her hands.
The voice of Sakaguchi came from the other side of the field.
SatsukiOpen your eyes. But there were only vague figures in that direction.
Sakaguchi looks up. As close as her eyes could focus.
Satsuki stared at him who finally became a little clearer.

"The most uncomfortable part is now."

"The appendix has been found."

"A little more."

The pulling continues. Her shoulders began to shake. Yurika saw it. Slowly walk to the side of your head. Do not enter the sterile field. She reached out and touched Satsuki's shoulder exposed outside the sheet.
Yurika held out her hand to her.
"It must have been the same when you pushed me that day."
"You were already asleep at that time."
"So today I watch it for myself that day."
Sakaguchi continues. Mesangial treatment. Roots exposed.
Satsuki felt another heavy pull in her abdomen. She inhaled sharply.
It was the first time during this incident that he had called her by her given name. Satsuki visibly paused, then truly looked up. Sakaguchi stood just close enough for her to make him out.
Ligation completed. Appendectomy. The upward pulling feeling suddenly eased. Satsuki let out a long breath.
Satsuki is still holding on to Yurika.
"It turns out that mine was removed in the same way."
SatsukiClose your eyes for a few seconds.
Followed by irrigation and hemostasis. The incisions begin to close layer by layer. Satsuki can still feel the pull and pressure. But it's not as strong as before.
Yurika's hand was still held by her.

"Because you were under general anesthesia that day."

"I can still talk today."
The last layer of stitching is finished. Apply the dressing. Sakaguchi back away.
Satsuki looked in his direction. This time she did not smile. She was completely serious.

[After surgery - "I know you didn't escape"]
Recovery room. Satsuki slowly wakes up. The regional anesthesia has not completely worn off. She still doesn't have glasses. The first reaction was to squint.
The answer came immediately from beside her:
"When you were a patient, you were more nervous than me."
"What does this have to do with being nervous or not?"
Satsuki is speechless. Yurika laughs. Laughed for a while. Be quiet.
"I didn't suddenly feel like you were fine that day just because you got stabbed today."
Satsuki looked at the blurry figure. long time.

[Sakaguchi and Satsuki — “Come a Little Closer”]
Yurika left. Sakaguchi came to check Satsuki’s postoperative condition. He stood at his usual rounding distance, and Satsuki could see only a blurred outline.
Satsuki is not trying to be brave.
“When a patient says ‘it’s okay’, it really doesn’t mean it’s okay.”
Sakaguchi said nothing. Satsuki kept squinting, trying to see him clearly. At last, she spoke first:
"Can you... come a little bit further?"
Sakaguchi looked at her, then stepped closer—into the distance at which she could see him clearly. Satsuki held his gaze and did not look away.
The words came out. She herself froze first. Her face turned red a little bit.
"...It's not because of the glasses at all."
Satsuki turned her face to the other side. But the corners of her mouth couldn't help but curve.

[A few days later - recheck]
Nurse's station. Satsuki puts on the white nurse uniform again. Black-rimmed glasses also returned to her face. She holds the transfer information for the next patient. Go to the bed. Didn't look at the bed number first. Instead, see the patient first.
"Please tell me your complete name and date of birth in person."
The patient answered. Satsuki checked each item word by word: wristband, chart, and the patient herself. Only when all three matched did she mark the transport form and begin moving the stretcher.

Corridor lights extend forward. Recall Yurika:

"I know you didn't run away."

Recall Sakaguchi:

"Leave it to me."

Satsuki looks up.

strings.collections.special_events.or_acceptance: Asuka marked today on the hospital-wide schedule several days ago: acceptance inspection and team training for the new operating room. Every device, procedure, and role must be checked again before formal opening.

strings.collections.staff.doc_aoi.name: Narumi Jinguji

strings.collections.staff.doc_emiko.personality: Aloof, confident, and forceful in her judgment, with a habit of taking control. Once she truly loves someone, she is exceptionally devoted.

strings.collections.staff.nurse_ange.personality: Intelligent, hardworking, and professionally assertive. Emotionally expressive, with an occasional impulsive or willful streak.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_haru.name: Ren Nanase
strings.collections.staff.nurse_haru.personality: Perceptive and pragmatic, with a strong respect for ordinary life. Usually reserved, but unwavering where patient safety is concerned.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hiroko.name: Hiroko Sugimura
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hiroko.personali: Gentle and approachable, with quiet inner strength—the dependable big-sister nurse who takes care of everyone.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ishigami.name: Chizuru Ishigami
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ishigami.persona: A cool, taciturn and highly observant Head of Nursing. She almost never raises her voice, yet can restore order across the nursing service with a few calm words.

strings.collections.staff.nurse_rin.personality: Mature, easygoing, reliable, and restrained. She readily sees through what patients conceal, yet rarely discusses her own past.

strings.collections.staff.pharmacist_manami.name: Manami Iimura

strings.collections.staff.visiting_futaba.name: Futaba Sakura

strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_advice.text: I've read your résumé, Dr. Sakaguchi. But a résumé only says what you have done before. Starting today, we'll see how you judge a situation and how you speak in front of a patient. If you're unsure, ask. You don't need to force yourself to look like a seasoned doctor.
strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_composed.text: Good. The pace here can accelerate without warning, though. Keep up when you can, and speak up when you cannot. Saying something in time is also part of a doctor's judgment.
strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_first_impression.text: The person assigned to meet Ryuji Sakaguchi is already waiting by the window. She holds a chart against her chest, her white coat immaculate. When she sees him, her gaze first settles on his name badge, and only then does a faint smile appear. It is less a rehearsed welcome than the manner of a senior doctor accustomed to observing before she speaks.
strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_honest.text: It's normal to be nervous. The real danger is being too tense to hear anyone else while pretending you know everything. Just stay as you are now.
strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_question.choices.1.la: I'll get up to speed as quickly as I can.
strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_question.text: Your first day in an unfamiliar hospital—are you nervous?
strings.dialogue.nodes.aoi_welcome.text: Good morning. Dr. Sakaguchi, correct? I'm Narumi Jinguji from General Surgery. I'll show you around today.
strings.dialogue.nodes.arrival.text: April sunlight streams through the glass corridor of Hoshimi Hospital. After completing his training overseas, Ryuji Sakaguchi had not planned to choose his next post immediately. With his record, he had more prominent options.
strings.dialogue.nodes.clinic_handover.text: This is your examination room, Dr. Sakaguchi. The first patient has arrived, and I'll be nearby to assist. When you're ready, we can begin.
strings.dialogue.nodes.clinic_walk.text: Ren Nanase opens the door at the end of the corridor. Charts, a stethoscope, and newly delivered test forms are arranged neatly on the desk. Beyond the door comes the muted conversation of waiting patients. Only now does the reality of a first day about to begin truly settle in.
strings.dialogue.nodes.first_day.text: The scent of disinfectant is faint. A cart rattles past the corner. The new name badge in his white-coat pocket rests against his chest. Today is Ryuji Sakaguchi's first day here.
strings.dialogue.nodes.haru_arrival.text: As she finishes speaking, light but measured footsteps approach from the other end of the corridor. A nurse carrying neatly arranged outpatient files stops before them, nods first to Dr. Jinguji, then turns to Sakaguchi.
strings.dialogue.nodes.haru_first_impression.tex: She keeps her eyes on Sakaguchi as she speaks. Her voice is gentle, but the movement with which she hands him the files is crisp and efficient. Colored tabs line the pages, and even the ward and operating-room locations he has not yet asked about are marked with brief notes.
strings.dialogue.nodes.haru_intro.text: It's nice to meet you. I'm Ren Nanase. I mainly handle surgical nursing and today's coordination. Your outpatient files are ready. If you cannot find someone later, come to the nurses' station first. You can usually find me there.
strings.dialogue.nodes.haru_invite.text: We have a little time before the first patient's appointment. Let's stop by the nurses' station and meet today's team. Then I'll take you to the examination room.
strings.dialogue.nodes.mentor_recommendation.tex:
What finally brought him to Hoshimi Hospital was a recommendation from his medical-school mentor.
“If you still haven't decided where to go, give this place a try.”
strings.dialogue.nodes.one_year_contract.text: Sakaguchi ultimately signed a one-year contract. For now, Hoshimi was simply a place to settle after returning to Japan.
strings.dialogue.nodes.rin_impression.text: Nurse Nakai turns to the next page of her handoff sheet. Her tone is almost stern in its brevity, yet she has already written an extension number beside Sakaguchi's name. She seems like someone who prepares everything one step ahead.
strings.dialogue.nodes.rin_intro.text: Mika Nakai. I mainly handle ward care. I'll verify inpatient preparation, handoff, and postoperative observations with you. When you need help from the ward, say exactly what you need. No need to talk around it.
strings.dialogue.nodes.sayaka_boundary.text:
“Call it a Hoshimi specialty.”
She slides the last page into her folder, her smile carrying the calm of someone who knows exactly what she is saying.
“You can ask me for ordinary assistance or cross-department coverage. If something is beyond me, I'll say so myself. Being able to admit what you cannot do is also part of being a doctor.”
strings.dialogue.nodes.sayaka_generalist.text: “Does that count as introducing your department?”
Soon after they leave the nurses' station, a figure rounds the corner and stops short. Sakaguchi checks his step just in time; their shoulders miss each other by inches. Several health-management forms slip from her arms.
strings.dialogue.nodes.sayaka_intro.text:
“That was close. Are you hurt?”
She crouches to gather the papers, then looks up at the new badge on Sakaguchi's chest.
“Dr. Ryuji Sakaguchi? I'm Sayaka Nanjo. General practice, health management—and whenever another department suddenly needs a doctor, I may get dropped in there too.”
strings.dialogue.nodes.sayaka_tease.text:
“And you've been staring at me because you're trying to remember a new colleague's face, right?”
Before Sakaguchi can answer, she has already stepped aside to clear the corridor.
“Let's record your answer as ‘yes’ for now. Don't be late on your first day, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
strings.dialogue.nodes.station_close.text: For your first day, remembering the three of us is enough. There will be more staff on future shifts, but you have met everyone you will need in the clinic and ward today. Come on—I'll show you your examination room.
strings.dialogue.nodes.station_haru.text: This is the nurses' station. The morning team is small today, so the names should be easy to remember—Senior Nurse Nakai, and Asakura.
strings.dialogue.nodes.station_walk.text: Sakaguchi follows Ren Nanase. She walks half a step ahead at a slower pace, pointing out the medication room, the ward passage, and the doors leading to the surgical area. The ringing phones and tapping keyboards of the nurses' station grow clearer.
strings.dialogue.nodes.yui_impression.text: Nurse Asakura laughs before anyone else can. Her Hoshimi badge is brand new, but the notes in her pocket already sort the hospital's equipment models and handoff sequence into neat categories. Her energy briefly lightens the busy station.
strings.dialogue.nodes.yui_intro.text: I'm Miyuki Asakura, and I'm supporting the clinic today! I've worked in nursing for several years, but this is my first day at Hoshimi, so I'll confirm the hospital's procedures from the beginning. You can leave blood draws, test arrangements, and patient transport to me. Oh—if I ask too many questions, don't take it to mean I can't do the job.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_ann.encounter.fu: "Wait a minute, why do you have to take off all your clothes for a basic physical examination? Even underwear is not allowed?" (They said it too naturally. The clinic is not a dressing room.)

"That's pretty much it. Just make it clear where you want to check. Don't tell me to take it all off with just one sentence." (The medical record will probably say that I am not cooperative. Let them do it.)

"Okay, you said this is a requirement for a complete physical examination. I will cooperate. If you have seen enough, check it out quickly." (Speak harder, but still freeze when you reach your hands behind your back. No one of them evaded.) She was still unconvinced, but she moved quickly. After taking off all her clothes, she stood at the position you designated and completed the basic physical examination.

"...Okay. Since you said you would come in order, I will cooperate." (You really have to leave nothing behind. No matter how gentle you say it, it is still embarrassing to stand naked in front of them.) She took off her clothes until nothing was left; the doctors and nurses continued to prepare records at the original pace, and you then completed the basic physical examination.

"Are you going to press me for refusing treatment? Okay, I'll take it off and stop talking." (That's too despicable. But they were already waiting, and in the end they could only put all the clothes in the tray.) She gritted her teeth and took off all her clothes, letting the nurse take them away, and completed the basic physical examination with anger.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_ann.exclusive_cg: Dr. Sakaguchi accepts the scalpel from the scrub nurse and holds it above the marked incision. Anna Takahashi trembles at the sight of the blade. “D-doctor, are you really going to cut me open?”
Anna Takahashi · The scalpel is ready to operate
The surgical team applies antiseptic outward from the center of the operative field and waits for it to dry.
